name: Boschporus Döner Kebap
kurzbeschreibung:
**Boschporus Döner Kebap in Ehrwald**

Discover the authentic flavors of **Boschporus Döner Kebap** in the charming village of **Ehrwald**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This beloved spot offers delicious, freshly prepared **Döner Kebap**, where every bite brings you a taste of the **Boschporus** tradition—right in the Alps.

Whether you're craving a classic **Döner Kebap**, a flavorful **Döner Pide**, or a hearty **Döner Platte**, **Boschporus** delivers with generous portions and a warm, inviting atmosphere. Pair your meal with a cold drink or a traditional **Tiroler Bier** for the perfect experience.

Located in the picturesque **Ehrwald**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this eatery is a must-visit for food lovers exploring the region. Don’t miss the chance to savor **Boschporus**—where **Döner Kebap** meets **Tiroler** hospitality!
